threads.body: [General] Endpoint propagation currently depends on the optional connection instrumenter starting. `shouldStart()` returns false when connection telemetry is disabled (the documented default), so this line is never reached; `ConstructorAdvice` then sees no `CONNECT_URI_KEY`, leaving every command without `server.address`/`server.port` under the default configuration. Please establish the URI context independently of the connection span decision (and add a default-config regression test).

replies.body:
Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/commit/1529e69391a69701b93e44a54b4365ad02c17f2e.

Redis URI propagation now occurs even when connection telemetry is disabled, with the default and opt-in configurations covered separately.
